scenarios.title: Steady organic growth
scenarios.description: Retail buyers arrive at a slowly rising rate (6 a day, rising to 11). Holders take profit at their own target, a few churn out each day, and six early holders never sell. No burns.

scenarios.title: Pump and dump
scenarios.description: Five whales put 800 to 1,500 BU each into the fair launch, hype brings 50 buyers a day for five days, then the whales sell everything between days 4 and 7. Arrivals fall to 6 a day and holders under water panic-sell.

scenarios.title: Challenge war
scenarios.description: The steady scenario plus a weekly seat challenge. Three early holders challenge the 50% seat, aiming just past the challenge minimum, and three defend it. All burns in a week are capped at 1% of supply, and the cap binds in most weeks.

scenarios.title: Run to graduation, then Index mode
scenarios.description: Strong demand (150 buyers a day for ten days) carries the curve to graduation within about a week and the coin graduates into its pool. Then demand fades to 10 buyers a day: each seller gets the better of the pool and redeeming, and arbitrageurs buy and redeem whenever the pool trades below the floor.

scenarios.title: NEAR memes basket
scenarios.description: A $COOK-style coin whose basket is three NEAR memecoins (JAMBO from meme.cooking anchored, BLACKDRAGON, PEPE), so each seat is a third of the vault and the basket's dollar value swings 10% a day instead of 3%. A hype week brings 30 buyers a day, then 8. Holders panic faster when under water, and every week they vote on a seat, as in the challenge war.
